definitions.explanation: A form filled out before seeing a doctor, asking about symptoms, medical history, and allergies.

examples.japanese: {問診票|もんしんひょう}に{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill out the medical questionnaire.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}の{方|かた}は{問診票|もんしんひょう}をお{書|か}きください。
examples.english: First-time patients, please fill out the questionnaire.

examples.japanese: {問診票|もんしんひょう}には{現在|げんざい}の{症状|しょうじょう}やアレルギーの{有無|うむ}を{書|か}く{欄|らん}がある。
examples.english: The medical questionnaire has sections for current symptoms and whether you have allergies.

notes:
{問診票|もんしんひょう} is used to gather patient information before consultation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {問診票|もんしんひょう}に{記入|きにゅう}する (to fill in the questionnaire)
- {問診票|もんしんひょう}を{書|か}く (to fill out the questionnaire)

TYPICAL QUESTIONS:
- {症状|しょうじょう} (symptoms)
- {既往歴|きおうれき} (medical history)
- アレルギー (allergies)
- {服用中|ふくようちゅう}の{薬|くすり} (current medications)

RELATED TERMS:
- {問診|もんしん}: medical interview
- {診察券|しんさつけん}: patient registration card
- {受付|うけつけ}: reception
